_meta.description: Candidate source tracker for Feldenkrais lesson discovery

statuses.discovered: Found via search, not yet evaluated
statuses.approved: Confirmed as lesson content, ready for seed script
statuses.rejected: Not useful (not lessons, too small, duplicate)
statuses.dead_end: URL dead, domain parked, or content removed — never revisit

candidates.title: Lavinia Plonka
candidates.snippet: Free samples plus $3.99/lesson MP3 downloads. Back pain, posture, walking, hands.
candidates.evaluation: GCFP 30+ yrs, Asheville NC. Free audio lessons + single downloads at $3.99/MP3 + multi-lesson bundles (CD/MP3). Products: Fall Softly (7 lessons), Stop Sciatica, Pelvic Health (3 CDs), Dynamic Musician, Arms & Hands, San Francisco Evening Class, Elusive Obvious, Comfortable Flight. Also live Zoom classes. Body language expert, author, Shift Network faculty.
